Elizabeth Smith-McCrossin was first elected to the Nova Scotia House of Assembly as a Progressive Conservative MLA for Cumberland North in 2017 and was re-elected in 2021 and 2024 as an Independent.

She was an owner of 4 businesses and she has been a registered nurse since 1991.
